title: tests.json
description: The generated tests and the recorded calls each one reproduces. A callIndex appears in at most one test; a call that appears in no test has no test.

testId.description: Chosen by the backend. The extension doesn't interpret it: it only passes it back to run-tests unchanged. If it contains `#`, the part before the first `#` is shown as the test's group (e.g. its class) and the rest as its name; otherwise the whole `testId` is the name.

callIndices.description: The calls this test reproduces, ascending. Empty for a synthetic test (an input combination that never occurred in the run).
